evidence.snippet: before: "Read social timeline posts, fetch comments on a post, or reply to a comment across connected social channels." → after: "Read social timeline posts (optionally with matching comments attached via includeComments: true), fetch comments (filterable by platform, integrationId, postId, or unreplied only), fetch member reactions on a post, or reply to a comment across connected social channels."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
